long_biography.plain_text:
Andrea Pignataro shaped ION around a problem he observed in finance: skilled people were spending time on decisions that algorithms and software could automate. His research training and bond-market experience informed a company designed to digitise recurring financial processes rather than merely supply market information.

Acquisitions became ION's method of extending that system. Dealogic added market analytics and content, Fidessa trading technology, and Cerved business information. Pignataro has described the group as combining the execution discipline of an investment fund with the permanent horizon of an industrial holding company. It buys for continued ownership, while he remains founder and chief executive.
